summary: The PR builds the glue rotation (component permutation plus D₄ label cycle) and its quadratic-preservation proofs by hand, when TauCeti already supplies the permutation combinator `piGlueAlphabetCongr`, componentwise `QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.pi`, and the D₄ triality action on the glue alphabet via `typeD4Triality`. The table-word membership check and subgroup-preservation argument are new and fine.
